To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have grown large single crystals of the Ba-Ni clathrate III phase with a Ni content of 3.5, and have measured the physical properties of this phase.
single-crystalline clathrate Ba8Ni3.0Ge42.1Cl0.4 exhibits metallic behavior, a high resistivity at 300 K (ρ = 1 mΩ cm) and a charge carrier concentration of n = 2.3 × 10 ^{19} cm ^{−3}.
single crystals of clathrate Ba8Ni3,5Ge42,1□0,4 have a high charge carrier concentration, which is responsible for their low electrical resistivity and metallic conductivity.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis and characterization of clathrate II compounds in the Ba-Na-Ge ternary systems with a focus on the influence of the chemical composition and the crystallographic structure on the electronic properties.
the synthesis, crystallographic and chemical characterization of single-crystalline clathrate phases in the Ba-Ge-Ni system and the study of their electronic properties.
the synthesis, crystal growth, and characterization of single crystals of clathrate II-type compounds.
